definitions.explanation: The individual being discussed; the person in question.

examples.japanese: {本人|ほんにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{聞|き}いてください→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
{本人|ほんにん}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦{本人|ほんにん}{確認|かくにん}→本人確認：noentry⟧ = identity verification

examples.japanese: {本人|ほんにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}らないようだ→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The person himself seems to know nothing.

examples.japanese: {本人|ほんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なければ、⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}えてはいけない→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: You must not share personal information with others without the person's consent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧みんな⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧しているのに、{本人|ほんにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{気|き}にしていない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone around is worried, but the person himself doesn't seem bothered at all.

notes:
USAGE: {本人|ほんにん} emphasizes that you're referring to the actual person involved, not someone else on their behalf.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本人|ほんにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (to the person himself)
・{本人|ほんにん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the person himself)
・{本人|ほんにん}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (identity verification)
・{本人|ほんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧ (the person's own will)
・{本人|ほんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：noentry⟧ (the person's own wish)
